title: TorchCurves: Differentiable Parametric Curves
abstract: arXiv:2611.14516v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present TorchCurves, a PyTorch library that treats vector-valued parametric curves as learnable primitives. Its central operation maps batches of scalar inputs to points on curves represented in B-spline or Legendre polynomial bases, with differentiation through both inputs and coefficients. Curve coefficients can be optimized jointly with the surrounding model or produced by another network. The library provides trainable modules, reusable basis modules, and a functional interface, supporting applications ranging from continuous feature embeddings to Kolmogorov-Arnold networks and functional regression. Its implementation combines classical evaluation algorithms with vectorized PyTorch operations, emphasizing readability and maintainability without custom hardware kernels. tldr: TorchCurves是一个将B样条和勒让德多项式参数曲线作为可学习基元的可微分PyTorch库，支持端到端优化，可广泛应用于连续特征嵌入、KAN网络和函数回归等任务。
en_tdlr: TorchCurves is a differentiable PyTorch library that treats B-spline and Legendre polynomial parametric curves as learnable primitives, enabling end-to-end optimization for applications such as continuous feature embeddings, Kolmogorov-Arnold networks, and functional regression.
